title: Quadratic circuit witness
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and let $w$ be an assignment of Boolean values to its input bits. Form a vector over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with $1+n+g$ coordinates: its constant coordinate is $1$, its input coordinates encode the values of $w$, and its gate coordinates encode the values produced by evaluating the corresponding gates of $C$ on $w$.
